projection.basis: The plan's western gallery has parallel vertical walls and horizontal partitions; the northern rooms genuinely turn relative to that wing. No perspective or axonometric correction is applied to that architectural angle.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: PDF p2 visually checked: orthographic, with an actually angled north wing. Do not straighten this architectural angle. Black source paths 0-144 are wall contours, 145-177 and 546 are display furniture, 178-231 are staircase details. Red artwork/audio-tour symbols are not rooms or walls. All eight Sala numbers manually transcribed at the source label positions.
